In his late twenties, he went to Austria and classified minerals by their physical attributes. This new classification system of his led to conflicts with many mineralogists who followed the conventional methods. In 1812, Mohs was appointed Professor of Mineralogy at the Joanneum, where he developed the Mohs Scale of Mineral Hardness. Mohs ended his remarkable career at the Mining University in Leoben and died at the age of 66 in Italy.

In his late twenties, he went to Austria and classified minerals by their physical attributes. This new classification system of his led to conflicts with many mineralogists who followed the conventional methods. In 1812, Mohs was appointed Professor of Mineralogy at the Joanneum, where he developed the Mohs Scale of Mineral Hardness. Mohs ended his remarkable career at the Mining University in Leoben and died at the age of 66 in Italy.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"극단적 표현이 포함된 진술"

det.korean: 진술 "극단적 표현이 포함된 진술"은 본문의 내용과 불일치한다.
det.analysis:
✅ False: 본문의 내용과 다르거나 언급되지 않은 내용이다.
❌ True: 본문과 불일치하므로 True는 오답.
det.tip: T/F 문제 — 진술의 핵심 키워드를 본문에서 찾아 정확히 대조하세요. 작은 차이가 정답을 바꿉니다.
